name: generation_audio_generate
description: Synchronously submit a legacy audio text-to-speech generation provider job and return its job id. Prefer generation_voiceover_generate for voiceover, generation_music_generate for music, generation_sfx_generate for sound effects, and generation_subtitle_* for subtitle AI jobs. Agent async lifecycle must be managed by core_work_start, not by calling this tool directly for user generation requests.

parameter_mode.description: Parameter handling mode. compatible maps or drops unsupported params when safe; strict returns an error for explicit unsupported params before submitting.

projectDir.description: MovScript project source directory. Generation tools read manifest metadata from this path.

cwd.description: Alias for projectDir when the provider passes the current project working directory.

projectUid.description: Optional manifest project_uid used to namespace generated job metadata.

input_resource_ids.description: MovScript RawResource IDs used as source audio/video/subtitle/script inputs for transcription, alignment, translation, or audio generation conditioning.

reference_resource_ids.description: MovScript RawResource IDs used as style or reference inputs when supported by the selected audio/subtitle model.

voice.description: Voice name or provider voice id.

source_language.description: Source language for subtitle transcription, alignment, or translation.

target_language.description: Target language for subtitle translation or voiceover localization.

subtitle_format.description: Requested subtitle format such as srt, vtt, ass, or json when supported.

style.description: Style prompt for music, sound effects, or voice performance when supported.
